senses.definition_en: A fee, akin to protection money, that business owners are obligated to pay to drug cartels for the "right" to operate their businesses in territories controlled by these criminal organizations.

examples.english: “Cobro de piso”, better known as “derecho de piso”, is an illegal tax imposed by criminals, which has become one of the most common extortion crimes in Mexico, affecting thousands of businesses and companies in the country. […] ¶ Although there is no exact figure, according to some shopkeepers who have been victims of “cobro de piso” or “derecho de piso”, the amount to be paid for this extortion ranges from 500 to 5 thousand pesos.
examples.ref: 2023 April 13, Enrique Pardo, “Cobro de piso, el “impuesto” ilegal de la delincuencia de México”, in TV Azteca, archived from the original on 16 Apr 2023:
examples.text: El cobro de piso, mejor conocido como derecho de piso se trata de un impuesto ilegal que realizan los delincuentes, el cual se ha convertido en uno de los delitos de extorsión más comunes de México, afectando a miles de comercios y empresas en el país.[…]¶ A pesar de que no existe una cifra exacta, de acuerdo con algunos comerciantes que han sido víctimas del cobro de piso o derecho de piso, el monto a pagar por esta extorsión oscila entre los 500 a 5 mil pesos.
examples.translation: “Cobro de piso”, better known as “derecho de piso”, is an illegal tax imposed by criminals, which has become one of the most common extortion crimes in Mexico, affecting thousands of businesses and companies in the country. […] ¶ Although there is no exact figure, according to some shopkeepers who have been victims of “cobro de piso” or “derecho de piso”, the amount to be paid for this extortion ranges from 500 to 5 thousand pesos.

glosses: A fee, akin to protection money, that business owners are obligated to pay to drug cartels for the "right" to operate their businesses in territories controlled by these criminal organizations.
